rows.author: Fluidkey (official channel t.me/fluidkey)
rows.summary: Official update: no unauthorized transactions since 18:05 UTC, when Fluidkey took all services offline; working with SEAL 911 on the investigation and fund tracing; full post-mortem promised; web app and all APIs stay paused; further updates via this channel and individual support chats. No root cause, loss figure or compensation yet.

rows.author: @tfortabasco
rows.summary: Thread claims accounts were drained on Base and other chains around 17:40-18:05 UTC, with at least ~$270k seen on-chain (unofficial figure); warns about fake 'Fluidkey support' DMs and address poisoning.

rows.author: TokenPost
rows.summary: Short report repeating Fluidkey's advice to stop using its website and app during the investigation; no cause, loss figures or timeline.

rows.author: ChainCatcher
rows.summary: Brief citing The Defiant: Fluidkey told users to temporarily stop using its site and app while investigating; no statement on affected funds. Time shown as 02:46 on Nov 20, assumed UTC+8.

rows.author: @DefiantNews
rows.summary: Reports Fluidkey told users to avoid its website and app during the investigation; notes the initial notice did not say whether funds were lost.

rows.author: Phemex News
rows.summary: Repeats Fluidkey's warning to stop using its website and mobile app; says the notice did not disclose whether funds were lost. Timestamp timezone not stated (assumed UTC).

rows.author: @pcaversaccio (security researcher)
rows.summary: Publishes 0xefdA52Af6848Ca8b08153A248B9d2A0bd488d247 as one of the main consolidation addresses so others can keep tracing.

rows.author: @SpikeDaGoad0
rows.summary: SCAM: reply recommending an individual account that 'fixes issues like this', a typical fund-recovery scam pitch aimed at victims. Do not contact.

rows.author: Several users (replies to @fluidkey)
rows.summary: Replies between about 18:35 and 19:05 UTC from users saying they were drained or are afraid to check; some tag Circle, Base, SEAL and ZachXBT asking for help.

rows.author: @fluidkey (official)
rows.summary: Official X post: aware of a security incident affecting Fluidkey users; recommends not interacting with the website and app while they investigate. Same wording as the Telegram notice.

rows.author: Fluidkey (official channel t.me/fluidkey, linked from fluidkey.com)
rows.summary: Official notice: Fluidkey says it is aware of a security incident affecting users and recommends not interacting with the Fluidkey website and app while it investigates. No root cause, loss figures or compensation mentioned.

rows.author: The Defiant
rows.summary: Reports that Fluidkey urged users to avoid its website and app during an investigation of a security incident; says the notice did not state whether funds were affected.

meta.label: Method
meta.value: Web search and public channel previews for posts about the Fluidkey incident. Summaries are paraphrased; open the link for the original.
